source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 7ης Αυγούστου — «Άγιος Σώζων από τη Νικομήδεια»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The whole of the entry is two sentences: «Τον έριξαν στη φωτιά και θαυματουργικά με τη θεία χάρη βγήκε αβλαβής. Στη συνέχεια απεβίωσε ειρηνικά» — they threw him into the fire and by divine grace he came out unharmed, and afterwards he died peacefully. **No `types` is written**, and that is deliberate: the couplet above calls him Μάρτυς, but the prose says he survived the fire and reposed in peace, so neither `martyr` nor `confessor` can be taken from the page without deciding something it does not say; the two readings are set out in the life and the question is in the report. He is neither of the two Sozons the corpus already keeps, `sozon-of-pompeiopolis` and `sozon-of-cyprus`, both of whom carry a venerated Greek row on 7 Σεπτεμβρίου; this one the listing places at Nicomedia and on 7 Αυγούστου, and neither of their rows is touched. There is no year, so there is no `dates` object. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page, which was grepped for there and not on the listing. The page prints no apolytikion and no kontakion, so this folder takes no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).
